whatsNew:
• Smart Primary 360° AVM Camera Discovery: Dynamically queries BYD hardware camera tags (pano_h / BmmCameraInfo) and probes 5120×960 panoramic resolution to lock onto the 360° AVM camera (ID 1) and prevent falling back to the Front DVR camera (ID 0).
• Exclusive Camera Slot Ownership: Cleanly detaches background warm-standby GL surfaces before attaching Touch Calibration Studio surfaces and restores them upon exit, preventing dead-slot lockups.
• Updated Day & Night Mode Hero Previews: Refreshed home screen mode preview cards with new geometric day and night artwork.
• Dual-Layer Vehicle Camera Detection: Vehicle Information now queries both Android Camera2 and native BYD JNIBMMCamera HAL to accurately display all available camera devices.
